title: args-to-Map guard repeated in 6 handlers
description: let Value::Object(mut args) = args else { return Err(...) } appears in handle_email_get, handle_email_query, handle_email_query_changes, handle_email_parse, handle_mailbox_get, handle_submission_get — candidate for a helpers::into_args_map helper, but 6 repetitions may not justify the abstraction cost; note for next contributor
